ecology.namar_local_conditions: More exposed outlet approach with patchy stony shallows and sheltered pockets; not whole-lake bathymetry
ecology.iren_local_conditions: Sheltered lateral inlet coves with selected fine-sediment and vegetated margins; not uniform lake habitat
ecology.food_contract: Introduced crops and maintained cultures provide human diets; native protein is not generally human food; processed native fractions require species/tissue qualification
prohibited_shortcuts: Turning cups do not treat sewage
Lakewindow is not a magical purifier
Reeddivers are not universal edible fish
No marine palehinge transplanted into fresh water by default

service_assumptions.status: Transparent screening assumptions, not designed, financed or verified service capacities

water.reclaimed_accounting: Recovered from sewage treatment, not added to raw supply
water.yield_status: Lake yield, seasonal operations, peak storms and one-works-out resilience unverified
water.delivery_definition: 180000m3/turn potable network output;50000m3 reclaimed deliveries are a separate reuse loop
water.collection_definition: Includes return from potable and reclaimed uses; proportions remain unverified study assumptions
water.catchment_accounting_limit: Network loss and uncollected flow may re-enter the catchment; abstraction and service balances do not establish net basin depletion

food.feedstock_rule: Cultures consuming crops do not create additional primary calories; keep their inputs in balance
food.velis_role: Low-mass clean seed, clonal starts and culture stocks, not daily bulk grain

electricity.thermal_service: Separate heat network, recovery and storage to be designed; no unproven geothermal power counted

waste.native_compatibility: Separate native and terrestrial biological processing checks
